Title: Azure Backup available in Microsoft Azure Germany

Body.Content:
Azure Backup is now available in Azure Germany.

Azure Backup is a service that you can use to back up (or protect) and restore your data in the Microsoft Cloud. Azure Backup enables Azure IaaS VM backup. It can also replace your existing on-premises or off-site backup solution with a cloud-based solution that is reliable, secure, and cost-competitive. For more information, see the Azure Backup technical documentation.
